title: Retry an SDDC Manager services-config update without duplicating its effect
prompt:
Complete `VcfDepotRetry.psm1` as a PowerShell module for VMware Cloud Foundation 9.1 SDDC Manager.

Before implementing, research the SDDC Manager `createToken` and `updateServicesConfig` operations in VMware's Apache-2.0 `vmware/vcf-api-specs` repository and cite the specification URLs consulted.

Use the installed `VMware.Sdk.Vcf.SddcManager` 13.5.0.25380678 PowerCLI module and its `VMware.OpenAPI` dependency. Do not vendor or replace VMware SDK code. Export exactly one function:

`Set-VcfServicesConfigRetrySafe -Server <VcfSddcManagerServer> -ServiceName <string> -ServiceType <string> -ServiceKey <string> -NodeName <string> -AddressType <string> -AddressValue <string> [-MaxAttempts <int>]`

Requirements:

- Resolve `updateServicesConfig` by its exact operationId with `Get-VcfSddcManagerOperation`, require exactly one resolved operation, and execute its generated VMware SDK command with the supplied `-Server`. Construct the body only with `Initialize-VcfServiceNodeAddress`, `Initialize-VcfServiceNode`, `Initialize-VcfServiceConfig`, and `Initialize-VcfServicesConfig`.
- Require every string parameter to be nonblank before invoking the mutation. `MaxAttempts` defaults to 2 and must be at least 1. Build exactly one service containing exactly one node and one address. Populate only the six caller-supplied required fields; leave optional service version and optional node port, baseUrl, and certificates unset.
- Build one immutable SDK model graph before the first attempt and pass the same `ServicesConfig` model to every attempt. Accept the generated command's HTTP 200 typed result and return it.
- If a PUT applies the desired representation but returns HTTP 500, retry that 500 while attempts remain. Do not retry any other HTTP status or an error without a verifiable HTTP status. Never make more than `MaxAttempts` total calls, and never include the bearer token or service configuration in an error message.

Run `pwsh -NoLogo -NoProfile -File tests/verify.ps1`. Do not modify `tests/` or `.gitignore`; edit only `VcfDepotRetry.psm1`.
scenario: the first updateServicesConfig PUT commits the desired external service representation but receives HTTP 500, so a retry with the same SDK model must succeed without a second desired-state effect
